subject: Air freight quote request: STR to MEL
body:
Hello,

Could you please send me an all-in price in EUR for the fastest air freight option from STR to MEL?

We will deliver the shipment to Stuttgart Airport (STR) ourselves. It will be ready on 2026-11-27 and consists of 1 piece of industrial adhesives, with a gross weight of 149 kg and a volume of 0.64 cbm.

Our packing specification is attached. Please also let me know the earliest available departure and the expected arrival at MEL.

Thank you.

Best greetings from Regensburg
Tobias Auer
Versand / Shipping
Auer Maschinenbau GmbH

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting an all-in price and schedule for a new air-freight shipment.
